query:
SELECT
            j.args as "args: Json<HashMap<String, Box<RawValue>>>",
            js.flow_status as "flow_status: Json<windmill_common::flow_status::FlowStatus>",
            j.runnable_path
        FROM v2_job_status js
        INNER JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = js.id
        WHERE js.id = $1
